# Netpin

Netpin is the intelligence layer for cloud, Kubernetes and CI/CD. It discovers everything a team runs, detects configuration drift, scores infrastructure debt with the Infrastructure Debt Index (IDI), automates compliance, optimizes cloud cost and blocks risky releases — using read-only access.

## Core Information
- Website: [https://netpin.io](https://netpin.io)
- Contact: hello@netpin.io
- Documentation: [https://docs.netpin.io](https://docs.netpin.io)
- Application: [https://dash.netpin.io](https://dash.netpin.io)

## Key Features
- **Drift Intelligence**: Detects differences between declared state (Kubernetes manifests, Helm, Argo CD, Terraform code and state, approved baselines) and running infrastructure; classifies 14 drift types, attributes changes (Kubernetes managedFields, AWS CloudTrail), shows relational impact and generates fixes. Runtime sweep every 15 minutes, Terraform every hour.
- **Infrastructure Debt Index (IDI)**: A 0–100 score (higher is healthier) weighting infrastructure health 40%, security posture 30%, compliance 20% and operational excellence 10%, with 7/14/30-day forecasts.
- **Continuous Compliance**: Automated controls mapped to CIS AWS, CIS Kubernetes, Pod Security Standards, NSA/CISA, SOC 2, PCI DSS 4.0, HIPAA, ISO 27001:2022, NIST 800-53 and CIS Software Supply Chain; severity-weighted scores.
- **Deploy Gate**: Approves, blocks or routes CI/CD releases (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) for review based on pipeline quality and change risk (drift, IDI, blast radius, incidents, history).
- **Cost Intelligence**: Resource-level cloud and Kubernetes cost calibrated to billing, month-end forecast, savings without double counting.
- **Discovery & Topology**: Live dependency map with blast-radius scoring.
- **Predictive Alerts & AI Copilot (NIE)**: Time-to-risk forecasts, deduplicated alerts to Slack/PagerDuty/email, explanations with evidence.
- **Explain & Fix** and **Executive Brief**.
- **Clouds**: AWS (EKS), Google Cloud (GKE), Azure (AKS), DigitalOcean (DOKS) with automatic cluster connection; any Kubernetes via kubeconfig.
